audit.whatIsWrong: Almost every ability reference on this page is a placeholder. Zaahen's kit is written as 'Ultimate' in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5], report[9] and report[13] — no real ability is named once. Worse, Darius's own E is called 'Apprehension' in whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0], spikes[1], early and wants.foe[1]. The ability is Apprehend.
audit.why: Zaahen's real kit: The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10/9/8/7/6) slashes twice, heals him, and recasts into a knockup off an auto-attack reset. Dreaded Return (W, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, 850 range) stabs and pulls you toward him — it out-ranges Apprehend's 535 by 315 units. Aureate Rush (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8) is a dash dealing percent-health damage. Grim Deliverance (R, 110/95/80, 600 range) damages and heals him for a portion of the damage dealt. His passive banks Determination for bonus AD and, when filled, lets him revive.
audit.corrected: Every 'Ultimate' placeholder that fits the length band is replaced with the real ability, its range and its cooldown; 'Apprehension' is corrected to Apprehend throughout.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, cooldowns and ranges
_missing headlines naming The Darkin Glaive, Dreaded Return, Aureate Rush, Grim Deliverance

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 is marked Darius in both layers while the page's own whys[1] and spikes[0] say 'Zaahen takes level 2' and call it 'his one real window'. phases[1].why also argues the Darius side ('E (Apprehend) is live — your kill threat starts here') at a level where Darius does not have E.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Zaahen/Darius/Skill/Skill/Darius/Darius. Zaahen owns level 2 because The Darkin Glaive already recasts into a knockup while Apprehend is not skilled until 3.
audit.corrected: Level 2 flipped to Zaahen at 4/10 in both layers and phases[1].why rewritten to explain the window instead of contradicting it. Every other row already matched the packet and was left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike list never mentions the two things that actually move this matchup's power curve: Grim Deliverance's heal at 6 (110s at rank 1) and the passive revive at full Determination.
audit.why: A revive is the single most important fact for a champion whose win condition is an execute. Noxian Guillotine's cooldown refreshes on a killing blow, which means the answer to the revive is the second cast, not the first.
audit.corrected: Level-6 why now names Grim Deliverance and its 110s cooldown; 'late' now states the revive and the refreshed-Guillotine answer.
sources: ownerKit R text (cooldown refreshed on killing blow)

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization buys Stridebreaker into a champion who heals off two abilities and deals percent-health damage, and never mentions Grievous Wounds. It also recommends Plated Steelcaps as if armour solved him.
audit.why: Two _missing rules fire here: 'needs-antiheal' (The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance both heal) and 'resistances-invalidated' (Aureate Rush is percent-health, so raw armour is the wrong answer).
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling moved ahead of the second item; the percent-health point is stated in dontsFull[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warns that his opener is an auto-attack reset, and nothing states that both sides carry displacement.
audit.why: _missing rules 'autoreset-burst-tell' (The Darkin Glaive) and 'knockup-enabler' (Apprehend vs The Darkin Glaive / Dreaded Return): the wind-up is the step-back cue, and whoever lands displacement first owns the trade — his W reaches 850 to your E's 535.
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[0] (the wind-up tell) and dontsFull[2] / breakdown.cooldowns (the 850-vs-535 pull race).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists 'Zaahen Ultimate' with no number and two generic self-referential lines.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Dreaded Return at 14s, not his ultimate; Aureate Rush at 8-10s is the follow-up, and Apprehend's own 26s at rank 1 is what you are protecting.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the real cooldowns on both sides.

notes: This page was almost entirely placeholder text: Zaahen's kit was written as the literal word 'Ultimate' in ten fields, and Darius's own E was called 'Apprehension' in six. Both are fixed. Level 2 flipped to Zaahen to match the packet levelChart and the page's own whys[1]/spikes[0]; every other chart row already agreed with the packet and was left untouched. Zaahen's passive name is not in the kit file (only the resource, Determination), so it is referred to as 'his passive' rather than invented. Not verified and therefore not written anywhere: whether Apprehend's pull can be cancelled by Aureate Rush mid-dash, whether the revive can be denied by Grievous Wounds, and whether Noxian Guillotine's refresh triggers off a kill that the passive then reverses.
